definition: Your state of mind — the game's core stat. High morale steadies you (and toughens you in a fight); low morale drags everything down. Shown as Despairing, Low, Steady, Good, High, or Elated.
How rested you are. It drains as you act and restores when you sleep. Shown as Fresh, Rested, Tired, Drowsy, or Exhausted.
How fed you are, by your own reckoning — Full down to Starving. Drifts down as the day passes; eat to restore it.
How hydrated you feel — Slaked down to Dry as dust. Drink to restore it.
How badly you need to relieve yourself — Empty down to Desperate.
How clean you feel — Fresh down to Reeking. Wash up to restore it.
Your composure — Serene down to Panicked. Drifts toward a middling steadiness over time.
Your inner reservoir of magic — Brimming down to Empty. Recovers with rest.
Mark a person as a favourite in the People menu to pin them to the top of your list.
The items you carry. Some can be used from the Inventory menu to recover energy or lift your morale.
Magic you have learned. Which spells you know depends on your tags; see the Spells menu.
A label a character carries (like 'dressed' or 'pyromancer'). Actions check your tags to decide whether you may take them.
Something you can do in a location or in combat. Each costs time; availability depends on your tags, the hour, and your stats.
You are in uniform. Required to attend lectures. Gained by changing clothes in your room.
You are a registered student. Nearly everyone at the Academy has this.
You are permitted to fight a formal duel. Duelists start with it; others earn it once a professor takes notice.
A caster trained in fire. Unlocks the Fire Wall action in combat.
A trained fighter. Unlocks the Brace action in combat and permits formal duels.
Raise a 3-tile wall of flame. Any unit that moves onto it or ends its turn on it is burned. Lasts a few rounds. Requires the Pyromancer tag.
Steady yourself, recovering a little health and ending your turn. Requires the Duelist tag.
A basic melee attack against an adjacent foe. Available to everyone.
Your dormitory. Where you dress, wash up, study privately, and sleep.
Where lectures are held on weekday mornings. You must be enrolled and dressed to attend.
A warded ring for magical combat. Spar with a dummy, or duel a rival if you may.
A scholarly classmate, often found in the classroom. Warm, and easy to confide in.
A gifted duelist who haunts the dueling room. Beating him earns real respect.
